Rounder corners. Rhys spotted that the 6th, 8th and 9th all had the same odd point of fairway sticking out past the corner of the dogleg. It came from how the fairway was measured at a bend: past the corner the distance across the line kept counting from the first leg, so the fairway ran on out in a spike. Now the outside of every bend is measured from the corner itself, so the fairway turns in a natural curve. The same fix applies to the ground near the line, so nothing else stretches out past a corner either.
The 9th's lean is now 3% across the landing area (it measured just under 2% after the change).
Everything else as round 4. All checks pass. Next: the build, the course in the game itself.
